connector.name: Omnicord
connector.registryDescription: Your AI runs your Discord server: chat, moderation, admin, even building it all from one brief.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package omnicord. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the orygnscode account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
env.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. The init wizard sets this up.

env.name: OMNICORD_GUILD
env.description: Optional default server id so tools can omit the guild parameter.
